description: Test suite for monitor-onchar module functions resolveOncharPrefixes and stripOncharPrefix using Vitest framework.

methods.name: resolveOncharPrefixes
methods.description: Resolves a list of prefixes, providing default values if undefined or containing only whitespace, and trims whitespace from each prefix.

methods.name: stripOncharPrefix
methods.description: Strips the first matching prefix from a given string, after trimming leading whitespace.
